compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is an advertisement for the Yelp app, which focuses on food, shopping, and services. The screen features the Yelp logo at the top, followed by a brief description of the app's purpose. It highlights the app's rating of 4.3 stars based on 300 thousand reviews and mentions that it has been downloaded 30 million times. The screen encourages users to find local businesses in their city using Yelp. At the bottom, there are two buttons: "NO THANKS" and "INSTALL," with the latter leading to the Google Play Store for app installation.
